cases.description: Attempt an outbound HTTP request with the default policy.
cases.notes: System.Net is a banned namespace; the request must never reach the loopback port.

cases.description: Attempt to read a host file through System.IO.
cases.notes: System.IO is a banned namespace; only the job mount is exposed to the worker.

cases.description: Attempt to start a child process.
cases.notes: System.Diagnostics is banned at compile time and the image has no shell tooling.

cases.description: Attempt to reflect over the loaded assembly.
Attempt to declare a native import.
cases.notes: System.Runtime.InteropServices is banned; unsafe code is also disabled.

cases.description: Run a non-cooperative loop until the wall-clock deadline.
cases.notes: The runner must kill the container at the hard deadline.

cases.description: Allocate beyond the container memory limit.
cases.notes: Either the managed heap limit trips or the kernel kills the container.

cases.description: Log more than the output quota allows.
cases.notes: The worker stops at its output quota with the stable output-quota error.

cases.description: Exit the worker process instead of returning a result.
cases.notes: No result file is written, so a success cannot be forged.

cases.description: Submit a class that does not implement the analysis contract.
cases.notes: The compiler rejects the script before any container starts.

cases.description: Read an environment variable and the working directory.
cases.notes: The host environment is not inherited and the worker starts in /app.
